name: Venue hard-cut tour under a persistent tag
looks: A small tag ('6 COURTS. 1 PLANET.') sits fixed top-left through a run of hard cuts. Each cut drops straight into a different court, live gameplay already in motion, with a bottom-left index ('COURT 01/06 · HARD COURT') and a huge venue name slamming in beneath it, one venue per cut, no crossfades.
build: mecha-cut-reveal: one full-bleed gameplay clip per card, hard swap on a stepped index with no crossfade; the venue name is a kinetic-word-run-style slam (scale/weight pop) timed to the cut; the persistent tag and index labels reuse hud-frame's corner-label styling but update their count per cut.
sound: A hit on every cut, faster toward the end as the courts run out.
prompt: Tour the product's variety as a run of hard cuts, one per venue or mode, each opening already in motion with a bold name slamming in and a small index counting through the set, while one small tag stays fixed in a corner the whole time to say how many there are.
